PROFILE SUMMARY

A highly skilled and results-driven Senior RPA Developer with over 8.2 years of hands-on experience in designing, developing, and implementing RPA solutions using leading automation tools such as Automation Anywhere ,UiPath ,Blue Prism and Power Automate Desktop. Adept at analyzing business processes, identifying automation opportunities, and delivering scalable, high-performance bots that streamline operations and enhance productivity. Proven expertise in end-to-end automation lifecycle, from requirement gathering and solution design to deployment and post-production support.

SKILLS

Automation Anywhere, Power automate Desktop,Uipath

JavaScript,Vbscript, Python

SQL,MS Access, Snowflake

Power Automate desktop and Cloud Flows

Microsoft Azure Admin Fundamentals

GitHub,Jira, Scrum

CERTIFICATES

Automation Anywhere Certified Master RPA Professional (Version11) AAMSTR-23298510

Automation Anywhere Certified Advanced RPA Professional (Version11) AAADVC-20024513

Automation Anywhere Certified Advanced RPA Professional (Automate 360) AAADVCA360-41281970

Automation Anywhere Certified Master RPA Professional (Automate 360) AMASTCA360-47187898

Completed diploma in UIPATH RPA developer foundation

MicroSoft Applied Skills Create Agent in MS Copilot Studio

Simplify Agent Development with Copilot Studio-Proficient

WORK EXPERIENCE

Tech Lead Wipro

2023/11 – present Hyderabad, India

Design, develop, and implement complex RPA solutions using leading automation tools such as Automation Anywhere ,UiPath and Power Automate Desktop. •Collaborate with business analysts and stakeholders to understand requirements and translate them into automated processes. •Build and configure bots, workflows, and automations while ensuring optimal performance and error handling. •Exposure of working on Blue prism to Power automate Migration project. •Taking business requirements and translating them into efficient and maintainable UiPath workflows. This includes considering factors like error handling, logging, and performance. •Choosing the right activities, orchestrators, and integrations based on project needs and best practices •Exposure to perform User Management, licence Management,Roles Management activities in Automation anywhere. •Conduct code reviews, ensuring best practices in RPA development are followed and promoting a culture of continuous learning. •Share technical expertise and provide support to team members across multiple RPA projects.

•Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including business users, IT, and operations, to ensure alignment on automation objectives and results.

Senior Developer Cognizant Technology and Solutions

Participating in daily scrum calls and getting required information. •Involving in design phase of SDD and other documents for different automations •Creation of Rule-based Robots, Automating existing Business Process. •Designing and developing automation workflows (desktop flows) to streamline business processes. •Experienced in handling of Data from different files formats like TEXT, PDF, CSV, Excel, and XML. •Expertise working with Object cloning, Web Recorder, Excel, PGP, Error handling, etc. •Taking business requirements and translating them into efficient and maintainable UiPath workflows. This includes considering factors like error handling, logging, and performance. •Choosing the right activities, orchestrators, and integrations based on project needs and best practices •Integrating Power Automate Desktop workflows with external systems, applications, databases, and APIs. •Experience in working with AA commands like Insert Keystrokes and Insert Mouse operations. •Expertise in Reading different Bank invoice files and entering fields into SAP and notifying them through email. •Experienced in analysing & Robotics automation development and also be a part of requirement gathering team in facilitating improvement in applications, planning and building effective environments •Exposure to varied fields like Banking, Insurance and Health Care Responsibilities: •Reading attachment from outlook mail and process those values with local excel file. •Development of functionality specific reusable components. •Creating comprehensive documentation for Power Automate Desktop workflows, including design specifications, user guides, and operational procedures.

Software Engineer Ampcus Tech Private limited

Having knowledge in analysing information system needs, evaluating end-user requirements. •custom designing solutions, troubleshooting for complex information systems management.

Software Engineer Dynpro India Private limited

Good VBA programming skills and good experience in development environment. •Ability to communicate ideas in both technical and user-friendly language. •Translate cell formulas in Excel into VBA code and use Excel-based VBA to design, analyse, and deploy programs for finance domain. •Experience in MS access and SQL. •Implement software user interface improvements based on client needs

EDUCATION

Bachelor of Technology In Computer sciences and engineering Sree Chaitanya Institute of Technological Sciences

Intermediate Education SR Education Institutions

LANGUAGES

English

Hindi

Telugu

2018/05 – 2018/07 Mumbai, Indai

2017/11 – 2018/03 Mumbai, India

2010/07 – 2014/08 Karimnagar, India

2008/06 – 2010/03 Karimnagar, India

PROFILE SUMMARY
A highly skilled and results-driven Senior RPA Developer with over 8.2 years of hands-on experience in designing, developing, and implementing RPA solutions using leading automation tools such as Automation Anywhere ,UiPath ,Blue Prism and Power Automate Desktop. Adept at analyzing business processes, identifying automation opportunities, and delivering scalable, high-performance bots that streamline operations and enhance productivity. Proven expertise in end-to-end automation lifecycle, from requirement gathering and solution design to deployment and post-production support.

sections.label: Experience
sections.text:
WORK EXPERIENCE
Tech Lead Wipro
2023/11 – present Hyderabad, India
Design, develop, and implement complex RPA solutions using leading automation tools such as Automation Anywhere ,UiPath and Power Automate Desktop. •Collaborate with business analysts and stakeholders to understand requirements and translate them into automated processes. •Build and configure bots, workflows, and automations while ensuring optimal performance and error handling. •Exposure of working on Blue prism to Power automate Migration project. •Taking business requirements and translating them into efficient and maintainable UiPath workflows. This includes considering factors like error handling, logging, and performance. •Choosing the right activities, orchestrators, and integrations based on project needs and best practices •Exposure to perform User Management, licence Management,Roles Management activities in Automation anywhere. •Conduct code reviews, ensuring best practices in RPA development are followed and promoting a culture of continuous learning. •Share technical expertise and provide support to team members across multiple RPA projects.
•Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including business users, IT, and operations, to ensure alignment on automation objectives and results.
Senior Developer Cognizant Technology and Solutions
Participating in daily scrum calls and getting required information. •Involving in design phase of SDD and other documents for different automations •Creation of Rule-based Robots, Automating existing Business Process. •Designing and developing automation workflows (desktop flows) to streamline business processes. •Experienced in handling of Data from different files formats like TEXT, PDF, CSV, Excel, and XML. •Expertise working with Object cloning, Web Recorder, Excel, PGP, Error handling, etc. •Taking business requirements and translating them into efficient and maintainable UiPath workflows. This includes considering factors like error handling, logging, and performance. •Choosing the right activities, orchestrators, and integrations based on project needs and best practices •Integrating Power Automate Desktop workflows with external systems, applications, databases, and APIs. •Experience in working with AA commands like Insert Keystrokes and Insert Mouse operations. •Expertise in Reading different Bank invoice files and entering fields into SAP and notifying them through email. •Experienced in analysing & Robotics automation development and also be a part of requirement gathering team in facilitating improvement in applications, planning and building effective environments •Exposure to varied fields like Banking, Insurance and Health Care Responsibilities: •Reading attachment from outlook mail and process those values with local excel file. •Development of functionality specific reusable components. •Creating comprehensive documentation for Power Automate Desktop workflows, including design specifications, user guides, and operational procedures.
Software Engineer Ampcus Tech Private limited
Having knowledge in analysing information system needs, evaluating end-user requirements. •custom designing solutions, troubleshooting for complex information systems management.
Software Engineer Dynpro India Private limited
Good VBA programming skills and good experience in development environment. •Ability to communicate ideas in both technical and user-friendly language. •Translate cell formulas in Excel into VBA code and use Excel-based VBA to design, analyse, and deploy programs for finance domain. •Experience in MS access and SQL. •Implement software user interface improvements based on client needs
2018/12 – 2023/10 Hyderabad, India
2018/05 – 2018/07 Mumbai, Indai
2017/11 – 2018/03 Mumbai, India
